name: Dotes categories
author: Michael Robbins
name_use: The name Dotes is free for anyone to use.

categories.name: Character
categories.lens_question: What was at stake, what did you choose, and what did the choice reveal?
categories.definition: Experiences in which values are tested or expressed through a choice: honesty, courage, empathy, fairness, responsibility.
categories.boundary: Character is not a moral score. A dote about a mistake, a regret or a change of mind can be among the most important a person tells.

subcategories.name: Integrity and Honesty
subcategories.intent: a time you told the truth or kept your word when it cost you something
starter_prompts: When did you tell the truth even though a lie would have been easier?
When did you keep a promise that turned out to be hard to keep?
Have you ever found, or been handed, something that wasn't yours? What did you do?

subcategories.name: Courage and Resilience
subcategories.intent: a time you did something hard or frightening, or kept going after a setback
starter_prompts: When did you stand up for someone, or for what was right, when others stayed quiet?
What is something you did even though it scared you?
Think of a setback you came back from. What did you do to keep going?

subcategories.name: Empathy and Compassion
subcategories.intent: a time you worked to understand what someone else was going through, and acted on it
starter_prompts: When did you notice someone was struggling and do something about it?
When did you change how you treated someone after you understood their side?
When did you give something up so someone else could have it?

subcategories.name: Responsibility and Accountability
subcategories.intent: a time you owned a mistake and made it right, or carried a responsibility others relied on, including at home
starter_prompts: Think of a mistake you owned up to. How did you make it right?
What do people count on you for, at home, at school or at work? Tell about a day it really mattered.
When did you take care of someone in your family, like watching a younger sibling or translating for a relative?

subcategories.name: Ethical Reflection and Growth
subcategories.intent: a time you changed your mind about what was right or fair, and why
starter_prompts: When did you change your mind about something after learning more?
What hard choice taught you something about yourself?
When did you think about what was fair for everyone, not just for you?

categories.name: Excellence
categories.lens_question: What were you working toward, and what happened along the way?
categories.definition: Experiences of setting a goal or standard and working to reach it, in school, sports, the arts, leadership or work.
categories.boundary: Excellence is not about being better than other people. Falling short, changing goals or deciding to stop can still show real growth.

subcategories.name: Academic and Intellectual Achievement
subcategories.intent: a time you worked hard to understand or master something, in school or on your own
starter_prompts: What subject or problem did you struggle with until it finally clicked? What did you do to get there?
What project are you proud you finished? What was the hardest part?
What did you teach yourself because you wanted to understand it?

subcategories.name: Creative and Artistic Achievement
subcategories.intent: a time you worked to reach a standard in an art, craft or performance
starter_prompts: What piece did you practice or rework until it met your own standard?
Tell about getting ready for a performance, show or exhibit.
When did feedback on your creative work help you get better?

subcategories.name: Athletic and Physical Achievement
subcategories.intent: a time you trained or pushed yourself toward a physical goal
starter_prompts: What physical goal did you train for? What did the training look like?
Tell about a game, race or match where you gave everything you had, win or lose.
What new move or skill did you work to learn with your body?

subcategories.name: Leadership and Initiative
subcategories.intent: a time you started something, or led others toward a goal
starter_prompts: What did you start that other people joined?
When did you organize people to get something done?
When did you keep a group going after things got hard?

subcategories.name: Work and Enterprise
subcategories.intent: a time you learned by working, earning or running something: a job, a business, a family enterprise
starter_prompts: What did you learn at a job, paid or unpaid?
When did you earn money by making, selling or doing something?
Tell about work other people depended on you for: a family business, a side job or work at home.

categories.name: Service
categories.lens_question: Who or what did you help, and what did you take responsibility for?
categories.definition: Experiences of helping, caring for, teaching, speaking up for or protecting people, communities, places or causes.
categories.boundary: Service is not measured in volunteer hours, and it is not limited to helping someone 'less fortunate.' Mutual aid, listening, caring for family and sharing power all count.

subcategories.name: Community Service and Mutual Aid
subcategories.intent: a time you helped meet a need in your community, alone or with others
starter_prompts: When did you help meet a need in your neighborhood or community?
When did people around you pitch in to help each other? What was your part?
What did you work on that made a place you care about better?

subcategories.name: Environmental Stewardship
subcategories.intent: a time you acted to care for a place, land, water or animals
starter_prompts: What did you do to care for a park, a garden, a stream or animals?
What habit did you change to waste less, and what happened?
When did you show someone else how to care for a place?

subcategories.name: Mentorship and Support
subcategories.intent: a time you helped someone else learn, grow or get through something
starter_prompts: When did you help someone learn something you know how to do?
When did you help a younger student, teammate or sibling through something hard?
What advice did you give that actually helped someone? What happened next?

subcategories.name: Advocacy and Civic Action
subcategories.intent: a time you spoke up or acted to change something for others
starter_prompts: When did you speak up about something that wasn't fair?
When did you work with others to change a rule, a decision or a situation?
What did you do after you learned about a problem in your community or the world?

subcategories.name: Inclusion and Kindness
subcategories.intent: a time you made room for someone who was left out or treated unfairly
starter_prompts: When did you make sure someone who was left out got included?
When did you welcome someone new?
When were you kind to someone others were treating unfairly?

categories.name: Relationships
categories.lens_question: What happened between you and others, and how did the connection change?
categories.definition: Experiences in which connections with family, friends, mentors, teammates or communities form, deepen, break or are repaired.
categories.boundary: This lens is about what happens between people, including conflict, distance, grief and reconciliation. The other person is part of the story.

subcategories.name: Friendship and Peer Support
subcategories.intent: a time you began or deepened a friendship, or a friend helped you through something
starter_prompts: How did one of your friendships begin?
When did a friend help you through something hard, or you helped them?
What did you and your friends build, plan or figure out together?

subcategories.name: Family and Generations
subcategories.intent: a time you connected with family or across generations, including caring for a family member
starter_prompts: What did an older family member teach you? How did they teach it?
What family tradition do you help keep going? What is your part?
When did you care for someone in your family, or they cared for you, in a way you still remember?

subcategories.name: Mentorship and Guidance
subcategories.intent: a time you were guided by someone older or more experienced, and what you did with it
starter_prompts: Which teacher, coach or mentor changed how you saw something? What did they do?
What advice did you get, what did you do with it, and what happened?
When did an older student or sibling help you get through something challenging?

subcategories.name: Community and Teamwork
subcategories.intent: a time you were part of a group that worked toward something together
starter_prompts: When did a group you were part of do something none of you could have done alone?
What was your role in a group project, and how did the group work together?
Where do you feel you truly belong? Tell about one day there.

subcategories.name: Conflict and Repair
subcategories.intent: a time you worked through a disagreement, made peace, forgave or were forgiven
starter_prompts: Think of a disagreement with a friend or family member that you worked through. How did you do it?
When did you help two people make peace?
When did you apologize to someone, or forgive someone? What changed afterward?

categories.name: Adventure
categories.lens_question: What was new to you, and what did it open up?
categories.definition: Experiences of curiosity and first encounters: a new subject, place, culture, skill or way of seeing.
categories.boundary: Adventure does not require travel, money or danger. A library book, a new neighborhood or a new school can open the world.

subcategories.name: Intellectual Curiosity
subcategories.intent: a time you followed a question into learning something new
starter_prompts: What question couldn't you stop asking, and where did it lead you?
What book, video or conversation made you want to learn more? What did you do next?
What puzzle or problem did you figure out on your own?

subcategories.name: New Places and New Beginnings
subcategories.intent: a time you went somewhere new or started over: a trip, a neighborhood, a new school, a move
starter_prompts: What place near where you live did you explore for the first time?
Tell about starting somewhere new: a new school, a new group or a new home.
Where did you go, near or far, that showed you something you had never seen?

subcategories.name: Creative Exploration
subcategories.intent: a time you tried a way of creating that was new to you
starter_prompts: When did you try a kind of creating you had never done before?
What did you experiment with, just to see what would happen?
What game, story or world did you invent?

subcategories.name: Cultural Encounter and Exchange
subcategories.intent: a time you met a culture, language or tradition new to you, or shared your own
starter_prompts: When did you learn a tradition, food, language or celebration that was new to you?
When did you share something from your own culture with other people?
When did you try to speak or understand a language you were still learning?

subcategories.name: Skills and Hobbies
subcategories.intent: a time you took up a skill or hobby and stayed with it long enough to learn
starter_prompts: What hobby did you start, and what kept you going?
What skill did you practice until you got noticeably better?
What club or group did you join because of something you love doing?

categories.name: Making
categories.lens_question: What did you bring into being, how did you make it, and why did it matter?
categories.definition: Experiences of designing, building, writing, composing, performing, coding, repairing or crafting something, alone or with others.
categories.boundary: Making is broader than art and does not require an original invention. Repairs, remixes, performances and group projects all count.

subcategories.name: Visual Art and Craft
subcategories.intent: a time you made something visual or by hand: a drawing, painting, sculpture, garment or craft
starter_prompts: What did you draw, paint, sculpt, sew or build by hand that matters to you?
What piece was hard to make, and how did you finish it?
Where did the idea for one of your pieces come from?

subcategories.name: Music and Performance
subcategories.intent: a time you composed, rehearsed or performed music, dance, theater or spoken word
starter_prompts: What song, dance, scene or poem did you write, learn or rehearse?
Tell about performing for other people. How did you get ready?
When did you make music or a performance with others?

subcategories.name: Writing and Storytelling
subcategories.intent: a time you wrote or told something that mattered to you
starter_prompts: What did you write that you are proud of, and what inspired it?
What letter, speech or message did you write that really mattered?
When did a story you told change how someone saw something?

subcategories.name: Invention, Design and Repair
subcategories.intent: a time you designed, built or fixed something to solve a problem
starter_prompts: What did you design or build to solve a problem?
What broken thing did you figure out how to fix?
What first try failed, and what did you change?

subcategories.name: Digital Creation
subcategories.intent: a time you made something with digital tools: a video, game, app, website, track or online community
starter_prompts: What video, game, app, website or track did you make with digital tools?
What did you build inside a game or an online world?
What online group or channel did you start or help run? What did running it teach you?

categories.name: Wellbeing
categories.lens_question: What affected your health or balance, and what did you learn about living well?
categories.definition: Experiences of caring for body, mind and spirit: movement, food, rest, emotional balance, purpose and connection to nature.
categories.boundary: Wellbeing does not judge bodies, food, feelings or rest. Dotes about health and emotions are private by default.

subcategories.name: Movement and Physical Activity
subcategories.intent: a time you took up or stayed with a way of moving your body, or came back after an injury or a break
starter_prompts: What way of moving your body did you start or stick with: a sport, dance, walking or play?
What physical challenge did you work up to? How did you prepare?
Tell about getting back to something you love after an injury or a long break.

subcategories.name: Food and Nourishment
subcategories.intent: a time you cooked, shared or learned about food: a family recipe, a meal for others, a tradition
starter_prompts: What did you cook or prepare for yourself or for others?
What family recipe or food tradition do you know? Who taught it to you?
Tell about a meal you shared that brought people together.

subcategories.name: Emotional Balance
subcategories.intent: a time you found your way through a hard feeling, or helped yourself steady
starter_prompts: What have you found that helps you through a hard day? How did you find it?
When did you talk something through with someone you trust?
How did you get through a stressful moment, and what would you do again?

subcategories.name: Rest and Renewal
subcategories.intent: a time you made room for rest or recovery and noticed what it gave you
starter_prompts: When did you choose to rest, and what did it give you?
What routine helps you recharge? How did you build it?
Where do you feel calm, and what do you do there?

subcategories.name: Personal and Spiritual Development
subcategories.intent: a time you connected with something larger than yourself: faith, nature, purpose or a big question
starter_prompts: When did you feel connected to something larger than yourself?
What big question about life have you wondered about, and where did it lead you?
What tradition, practice or place in nature helps you feel grounded?
